author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
For our May Dev Updates Stream, the team is previewing content arriving later this year during Season One, including a first look at the Crimson Veldt trial and the all-new High Seas of Tamriel in-game event. In addition, the team will also discuss Challenge Difficulty and dive into the player feedback for the ongoing Night Market event zone.

For this show, the team will welcome the following developers:   
Associate Design Director Mike Finnigan (Dungeons and Encounters)
Lead Narrative Designer Michael Zenke (ESO Lore Master)

Dev Updates is a new series of ESO livestreams where the ESO Community Team and developers showcase and highlight some of the things they’ve been working on over the past month. If you’d like to get a first look at what's coming next to ESO, then you won’t want to miss this!
title: ESO Dev Updates Livestream—May 2026
